scope: Durable, separate τ-Bench role-handoff step accounting and route limit; no public benchmark trial

source_contract.step_definition: Half-duplex Orchestrator.step increments once for each Agent/User/Environment role handoff
source_contract.multi_tool_batch: One tool-call batch handled by Environment is one step regardless of the number of tools in that batch

accounting: ReAct Agent action and Plan external action, including a semantic decide node, each consume one Agent step
Each user simulator reply consumes one User step
Each environment tool-call batch consumes one Environment step; MCP tool calls remain counted individually
Step reservation is persisted before the related simulator callback or business-tool side effect
Route resume preserves recorded step attempts; unknown routes are not replayed and receipts retain the ledger count
Model requests, MCP tool calls, Plan control steps, and τ steps remain separate counters
implementation.cap_behavior: At the route limit, the next simulated Agent/User/Environment action is stopped before its callback or business tool dispatch; official judge work is governed by its separate role budget

ruff.command: uv run --extra dev ruff check decagent evals

tau_pinned_runtime_integration.runtime: Pinned tau2-bench 96a3ef9 in isolated Python 3.12 worker
tau_pinned_runtime_integration.split: train engineering smoke; not official test split

key_regressions: 200-step route bound is enforced and persists across ledger close/reopen
step-limit exhaustion prevents the next tool dispatch
user multi-tool batch records one Environment step and one subsequent User step per simulator reply
Plan semantic decide node records an Agent step
unknown route receipt reports the durable τ step count
limitations: No real provider request or public four-domain first-wave route was performed. Three fixed τ train engineering routes (retail ReAct/Plan and telecom ReAct) used scripted model callbacks, original scoring, and verified cleanup; they are not public test-split scores.
The full live public runner and universal cancellation of arbitrary synchronous callbacks remain pending; run_public_trials.py --execute remains fail closed.
The 14 deterministic skips are not counted as PostgreSQL integration or benchmark validation.

OpenSpec task 9.6.C τ bridge engineering acceptance is complete for the scripted fixed train smoke only. Tasks 9.6.F/G and 10.10.D/E, formal public scores, and independent Linux acceptance remain incomplete; overall main change status is 65/78.
